name: jr-pkg-guard
description: Checks every package install against its registry first: names that do not exist (hallucinated or typosquatted) are refused, very new packages are held back or flagged, install scripts are flagged.

minAgeDays.title: Minimum age (days)
minAgeDays.description: Packages first published more recently than this are held back or flagged.

newPackages.title: New packages
newPackages.description: block: refuse the install. warn: install and show a toast.
